verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line on the Claude pricing page, "Hand off and schedule tasks". It suggests a first-party task-scheduling feature but does not say whether schedules can recur or how jobs and workflows are defined. The Batch API and Managed Agents cover asynchronous or long-running work, not scheduling, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of recurring schedules (cron-like intervals), API or programmatic schedule creation and management, workflow definition for scheduled runs, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
